sections.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: Gitlab runner auto scaling for CI / CD pipeline using AWS EC2 is a great option to spawn the instances based on the number of jobs that needs to scheduled. Understanding this article requires the reader to have basic understanding of gitlab and AWS.
Reader can follow the reference links to setup the AWS instance network, security policies. Also keep your amazonec2-access-key, amazonec2-secret-key ready.
